title: Von Däniken's ancient astronaut reading of the Nazca Lines

tellings.quote: Erich von Däniken, author of Chariots of the Gods, thought that they were tributes to ancient alien astronauts and extraterrestrial group that seeded human civilization.

plain: The Nazca Lines, huge markings on the ground at Nazca in Peru, were tributes to ancient alien astronauts, according to the writer Erich von Däniken, author of the book Chariots of the Gods. In this view they honoured an extraterrestrial group that seeded human civilization. Michels brings this up himself as von Däniken's idea, without endorsing it, while introducing a story about strange three-fingered bodies found in Peru.
